text_block_list.text: One, two! ♪ One, two! ♪
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Today, per her request, I join Curren
Chan at her
dance practice.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Suddenly, the door slams open.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Good mooorning! ☆ Another day,
another
spirited dance from yours tru—
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Curren?!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Wow, hiii! ♪ Are you and Flash gonna
practice
too?
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'm accompanying her today. She's
arrived
precisely five seconds late,
however.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Falcon? Why are you standing near the
entrance?
I do not think we can afford
to lose any more
time.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Oh, sorry... Uh, you see... I didn't think
Curren
would be here...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Aw, do you not want me here?
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
That's not what I mean! It's just that
when you're
here...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: It lights a fire in my heart!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: How wonderful.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: Ehehe. It really is. ♪
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Hm... So Falco's fired up for practice...
and Flash
is accompanying her...
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Ehe, that settles it! ♪ I'm gonna watch
your super
sharp dancing up close and
personal, Falco!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
I bet if I dance with you two, I can
sharpen up my
movements too. ☆
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
So, can I practice with y—no, just
watching would
even be okay. Can I?
Pweeeaaase?
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: Fwoosh!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
That stance! She's ready to instantly
grasp
everything we do and apply it to
her own
learning!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: You truly are a frightening one, Curren.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Falcon, we need to start practicing...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: On that note, I say...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Yeah! Pretty pleeease, Falco! ♪
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
All right, have it your way! Get ready to
dance
your behind off, Каррен Тян!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
And so, Каррен Тян continues to
dance, and
dance, and dance...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Straight to your heart, I send my love for
you! ☆
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: Sha-shing! ♪
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
...Wow, Curren. You're amazing. I didn't
expect
you to grasp so much so
quickly...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, that means a lot coming from
youuu!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: What about you, Big Bro? What did you think? ♪
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: What about you, Big Sis? What did you think? ♪
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, let's! After all, you can still learn a
lot from
watching.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: Hmmm...
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
It's helpful to understand other people's

perspective and way of thinking and
stuff. ♪
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Falcon, your arm is three degrees too
low.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: Awww, c'mon, Flash! You're too strict!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
That may be the case, but you were the
one who
asked me to accompany you.
Now your rhythm is
0.5 seconds off.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Wow! Flash is checking all the ins and
outs!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: Hmm, I see... I think I got it!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
It seems Каррен Тян has managed to
learn
something from observing Eishin
Flash.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Каррен Тян's dancing is sharper than
ever
before!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
